title: Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.1
description:
Explore new features and inspire limitless creativity: Version 2025.1 is fully upgraded.

For the first time, support for drawing panels in 3D space accelerates workflows, saves operation time, and unlocks more design possibilities.

Highlights of the new version:
📌 Draw panels in 3D space
📌 Maintain topology after automatic panel adjustments
📌 Panel Generator (Beta)
📌 Custom model soft simulation
📌 Denim washing effect
📌 AI Pose Generator (Beta)

🎬 Want to learn more?
Overview video of new features: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/zh/learn/newfeature

Update now and unleash your creativity with Marvelous Designer!
